findings.description: Critical: `plan_reconciliation` rejects `legacy_role_aliases` values unless they match `^(agent|service)-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`, but `migration-map.schema.json` and contracts/README define aliases as pre-migration role overrides matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`. The pre-pca-02 seeder created AppRoles named with the agent slug (for example `claude-web`), not `agent-claude-web`. Cutover safety then requires those names in `legacy_role_aliases` before deleting `coordinator-read`; schema-valid maps with real legacy names fail preflight, so confirmed cutover cannot retire the roles that still hold shared coordinator access.
findings.resolution: Validate alias values with the migration-map schema pattern (or the historical AppRole name charset), keep the collision check against projected `agent-|service-` role names, and add a cutover test that retires an alias named like `claude-web`.

findings.description: Critical: schema loading hard-codes `openspec/changes/restructure-openbao-per-agent-secrets/contracts`. OpenSpec archival moves that tree under `openspec/changes/archive/<date>-restructure-openbao-per-agent-secrets/`, so every apply/preflight that validates migration maps, topologies, bundles, or audit events fails the day the change is archived rather than when the contract drifts.
findings.resolution: Resolve contracts from the active change directory first, then the newest matching archive glob (or relocate the frozen schemas next to the runtime package). Add a unit test that proves archival lookup still works.

findings.description: Critical: `make bao-dev` now only runs the migration-map reconciler and never writes retained internal keys to `secret/coordinator`. Design D3 correctly keeps apply away from unrelated coordinator data, but this Makefile change removes the previous one-command path that populated the internal document `profile_loader` and `langfuse_env.sh` still read. Fresh local OpenBao brought up with `bao-dev` therefore has agent/vendor paths and bundles while the coordinator-internal path stays empty, breaking internal interpolation until an undocumented manual seed.
findings.resolution: Keep principal reconciliation free of coordinator writes, but restore an explicit Makefile companion step/target that writes only migration-map `retained_internal` keys to `BAO_SECRET_PATH` (root/admin token), and document the required `BAO_MIGRATION_MAP`/`BAO_BOOTSTRAP_DIR` plus that companion step. Escalate if ownership should move to wp-integration task 5.5 instead of this package.

findings.description: Nit: `seed_secrets`, `seed_approles`, and `seed_db_engine` remain importable and covered by tests even though `main()` no longer calls them. `seed_approles` still creates the shared `coordinator-read` policy and AppRoles named from `openbao_role_id`/agent slug, which conflicts with D3 exact-scope provisioning and makes it easy to reintroduce the legacy path beside the new reconciler.
findings.resolution: Delete the unused helpers and their tests from this package, or move them behind an explicitly named legacy module that is not part of the supported CLI.
